name: token-counter
description: Independently report Codex token usage locally, optionally share sanitized totals, and run requested Claude Code tasks with an Anthropic API key.

interface.longDescription: Re-tokenizes Codex rollout logs locally with a vendored o200k_base vocabulary instead of trusting reported aggregates, attributes every token to a category (system prompt, tool output, user message, reasoning), measures cached against uncached input from the canonical usage ledger, and renders a self-contained HTML dashboard, with how long responses, turns and tool calls took from the logs' own timestamps. Beside the token counts it shows what the recorded usage would cost at OpenAI's API list prices, from a vendored price table that is never fetched -- a value, not a bill -- and never translates tokens into rate-limit percentages. Nothing is intercepted at runtime, and the report stays on the machine unless you share it. A separate, opt-in skill shares daily token counts, per-session summaries and weekly rate-limit usage by plan, and publishes the report page itself -- never content, paths or account identity -- to the public leaderboard at tokenusage.dev, and only after a dry run and an explicit --yes. The separate cc-api skill runs a requested task through the user's installed Claude Code CLI with an Anthropic API key, billed to that key's Console organization under Anthropic's credit rules.
defaultPrompt: Build me a token report for all my Codex sessions
Which sessions waste the most tokens on resent tool output?
Share my token usage to the tokenusage.dev leaderboard
Use cc-api to summarize this project's README
